Bill Fish sends his heartfelt thanks to Club members for their kindness and sympathy during his recent illness. We are pleased to say that Bill is much better and we hope that he will enjoy watching many, many track meetings with us.

We regret that yet another Club stalwart in the person of Bill Fish, has passed away. He will be remembered by most of our present day members as the man who sat at the gate at Battersea and Tooting Tracks and we shall certainly miss his cheery face during the coming track season.

Members will learn with real regret of the death of our Life Member and Vice President, "Bill" Fish, which occurred on March 5th. Bill had been a club stalwart for many years and even in recent years, when gravely handicapped, he still managed to get to our track meetings and act as Chief Steward.

The President, Tom Morrell, took the chair and before the proceedings began, a short silence was observed in memory of the late Bill Fish who passed away earlier in the year following a street accident.
